description.value: The Wildcat Grill is an independently owned restaurant in Rosedale, BC, serving the Fraser Valley since 1996 and home of the famous Rowdy Rosedale Burger — three half-pound patties on half a loaf of French bread with all the trimmings. The menu spans burgers, prime aged beef, seafood, and salads in a sit-down dining room with an outdoor patio, and takeout is available seven nights a week. The location beside an Esso station near the Highway 9 and Yale Road roundabout makes it easy to spot from the road.
